glyph.isekai_mahou.dimensional_inventory: Opens your Item Box: a space of your own, outside the world. It is NOT dropped when you die. Grows with your Circle: 9 slots at C1 up to 54 at C9. Does not accept Shulkers, bundles or items that hold items. Use with Self.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dimension_gate.desc: Tears space: opens a two-way gate to a dimension you have ALREADY visited the normal way (arrives at the hub or the last solid ground you stood on). Lasts 30 s and carries whoever walks through, with their companions. On a block, opens there.
glyph.isekai_mahou.space_step.desc: Teleports you up to 12 blocks where you look, passing through thin walls (up to 3 blocks). On an enemy, shoves it through space along your gaze. With Invert: backwards.
glyph.isekai_mahou.return_mark.desc: First cast: records a mark where you stand. Afterwards: returns you to the mark from any distance (same dimension). Sneaking or with Invert: mark again. On an enemy, sends it to your mark.
glyph.isekai_mahou.space_gravity.desc: Suspends targets in the air for 3 s. With Invert: crushes them into the ground (fall damage). On a block: a well that pulls nearby enemies (Invert: repels). On yourself: weightless jump; mid-air with Invert: ground slam.
glyph.isekai_mahou.recover_belongings.de: Pulls the items of your LAST death through space (your Corpse and whatever was left on the ground), from any distance or dimension: everything returns to the slot it came from. Circle 7, high cost and a 10 min cooldown. Use with Self.
screen.isekai_mahou.space_magic.gate_hin: The gate stays open for %s s, on both sides.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.gate_no: You have not visited another dimension the normal way yet.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.gate_se: Space is sealed here — no gate can open.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.gate_no: There is no safe ground on the other side.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.gate_ex: The tear in space closed before you chose.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.step_bl: No free space to step into.
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.mark_ot: Your mark is in another dimension (%s).
message.isekai_mahou.space_magic.mark_se: A sealed arena binds space here.
